prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: low-speed head-on collision. Injury: concussion. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1483; do not mention it.)
text:
I write to present a settlement demand on behalf of our client, [CLIENT_NAME], arising from the motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was traveling at low speed when your insured's vehicle crossed into the oncoming lane and struck our client's car head-on. Although the impact was modest in speed, the force was sufficient to throw our client's head against the interior and cause a concussion.

Since the collision, our client has experienced persistent headaches, light sensitivity, dizziness, and difficulty concentrating. Treatment has included emergency evaluation, neurological follow-up, and a course of physical therapy aimed at vestibular recovery. Our client has missed substantial time from work and continues to limit activities that require sustained attention. Medical records and treating physician notes documenting these symptoms are enclosed.

Liability appears clear. Your insured left their lane of travel, and no reasonable explanation has been offered for the crossing. Our client bears no responsibility for the collision.

Accordingly, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve all claims arising from this incident. This offer remains open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a response within that period, we will file suit without further notice and seek all damages available under law.
